text: Kaveri Polymers: outcome of board meeting. The board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September.
Sahyadri Cement's quarterly profit fell as fuel costs rose and volumes stayed flat.
Narmada Textiles posts a net loss for the quarter, its third in a row.
Vindhya Power submits audited standalone and consolidated results for the financial year.
Deccan Auto Parts beats street estimates on revenue; margins improve on lower steel prices.
Konkan Shipping's operating profit doubled year on year on higher freight rates.
Malabar Spices: financial results for the half year, with the limited review report of the auditors.
Aravalli Mining reports lower quarterly revenue after monsoon rains disrupted output.
Ganga Finance's net interest income rises; asset quality steady in the quarter.
Godavari Pharma profit rises on US generics; the company also recommends a final dividend.
notes: Results plus dividend in one item. Single-label taxonomy forces a choice; the results are the main event. Overlap with DIVIDEND.

text: Nilgiri Tea: board approves quarterly results and keeps its full-year outlook unchanged.
notes: Mentions outlook, but no new guidance; GUIDANCE would need a change or a new number.

text: Satpura Steel swings to a quarterly profit from a loss a year ago.
Brahmaputra Logistics' revenue misses estimates as e-commerce volumes slow.
Tapti Chemicals: integrated filing (financial) for the quarter.
notes: Terse filing title; a rules-first classifier should catch it from the subject.

text: Chambal Agro reports record quarterly sales on a strong kharif season.
Kosi Infra: the board declared an interim dividend and fixed the record date.
Sindhu Software to pay a special dividend to mark its silver jubilee.
Pench Hospitality: intimation of record date for the final dividend.
Bhadra Bank skips its dividend this year to conserve capital.
Thar Solar: board recommends a final dividend, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM.
Kaziranga Foods raises its dividend payout ratio under a new capital allocation policy.
Western Ghats Electric: payment of second interim dividend completed.
Shares of Kaveri Polymers trade ex-dividend today.
Sahyadri Cement: TDS on dividend, communication to shareholders.
notes: Administrative notice about a dividend; low significance but still DIVIDEND.

text: Narmada Textiles declares its first dividend since listing.
Vindhya Power: board approves interim dividend for the year.
Deccan Auto Parts cuts its interim dividend as cash flows weaken.
Konkan Shipping: unclaimed dividend to be transferred to the investor protection fund.
notes: Judgement call: routine compliance notice. Could be OTHER.

text: Malabar Spices announces a dividend along with its annual results.
notes: Mirror of c010: here the headline leads with the dividend. Overlap with EARNINGS_RESULT; label follows the headline.

text: Aravalli Mining: record date for the interim dividend fixed for next Friday.
Ganga Finance: appointment of a new chief financial officer with effect from next month.
Godavari Pharma's managing director resigns, citing personal reasons.
Nilgiri Tea: re-appointment of the whole-time director for five years.
Satpura Steel names an outsider as its new chief executive.
Brahmaputra Logistics: resignation of an independent director before the end of term.
Tapti Chemicals: resignation of statutory auditor.
notes: Judgement call. An auditor is not management, and an auditor quitting can be a governance red flag. There is no GOVERNANCE type; MANAGEMENT_CHANGE is the closest.

text: Chambal Agro's founder steps down as chairman; his daughter takes over.
Kosi Infra: change in company secretary and compliance officer.
Sindhu Software loses its chief technology officer to a rival.
Pench Hospitality: appointment of two additional independent directors.
Bhadra Bank's board picks a new managing director; the regulator's approval is awaited.
notes: Mentions regulatory approval, but no regulatory action has happened yet.

text: Thar Solar: cessation of the nominee director after the lender withdrew its nomination.
Kaziranga Foods hires a former consumer goods executive as chief operating officer.
Western Ghats Electric: appointment of a new chief risk officer.
Kaveri Polymers' CFO and CEO both quit within a week.
Sahyadri Cement: receipt of a letter of award from a state highways authority.
Narmada Textiles wins an export order for technical fabrics.
Vindhya Power: emerged as the lowest bidder for a solar project with a power distribution company.
notes: Lowest bidder is not yet an award. Still labelled ORDER_WIN_CONTRACT; the interpretation should say it is not final.

text: Deccan Auto Parts signs a five-year supply contract with a two-wheeler maker.
Konkan Shipping: long-term charter agreement signed for two vessels.
Malabar Spices bags a contract to supply a global food chain.
Aravalli Mining: execution of a mine development and operator contract.
Sindhu Software wins a multi-year IT modernisation deal from a European insurer.
Kosi Infra: order inflow update, new orders received across road and water segments.
Satpura Steel loses a large railway contract to a rival bidder.
notes: A lost order still belongs to the order type; sentiment is negative.

text: Brahmaputra Logistics: memorandum of understanding with a port trust for warehousing.
notes: Judgement call: an MoU is not binding. Could be OTHER.

text: Tapti Chemicals signs an offtake agreement for its new specialty chemical.
Western Ghats Electric: receipt of purchase order from a metro rail corporation.
Chambal Agro wins a government tender to supply fertiliser.
Pench Hospitality signs management contracts for three new hotels.
Bhadra Bank: board approves raising capital through a qualified institutions placement.
Thar Solar raises money from a sovereign wealth fund through a preferential issue.
Kaziranga Foods: allotment of non-convertible debentures on a private placement basis.
Kaveri Polymers announces a rights issue to cut debt.
Sahyadri Cement: board to consider fundraising via equity or debt instruments.
notes: Only a proposal to consider. Same type, lower significance.

text: Narmada Textiles' QIP closes with strong demand from mutual funds.
Vindhya Power: issue of commercial paper.
Deccan Auto Parts takes a term loan from a consortium of banks for its new plant.
notes: Overlap with CAPACITY_EXPANSION: the loan funds a plant. Labelled by what was announced (the loan).

text: Konkan Shipping: allotment of warrants to the promoter group.
notes: Promoter warrants could also read as INSIDER_TRADE. Labelled FUNDRAISE because the company issues new shares.

text: Malabar Spices plans to list green bonds overseas.
Aravalli Mining: rights issue opens next Monday; letter of offer filed.
Ganga Finance raises funds through a securitisation deal with a large bank.
Godavari Pharma: shareholders approve an enabling resolution to raise capital.
Nilgiri Tea's promoter infuses fresh equity to fund working capital.
Satpura Steel: outcome of the debenture committee meeting, NCDs allotted.
Brahmaputra Logistics: a rating agency reaffirmed the long-term rating with a stable outlook.
Tapti Chemicals' debt rating is cut by one notch on weak cash flows.
Chambal Agro: credit rating upgraded for bank facilities.
A rating agency places Kosi Infra on watch with negative implications.
Sindhu Software: rating assigned to its proposed commercial paper programme.
notes: Overlap with FUNDRAISE (the paper is a fundraise). Labelled by the announced fact: a rating.

text: Pench Hospitality's outlook revised to positive from stable by a rating agency.
Bhadra Bank: rating agency withdraws the rating on redeemed bonds at the bank's request.
Thar Solar downgraded to default grade after missing a bond payment.
notes: A payment default is the bigger story; there is no DEFAULT type. Labelled by the rating action.

text: Kaziranga Foods: intimation of credit rating for long-term loans.
Kaveri Polymers' rating moved to 'issuer not cooperating' status.
Western Ghats Electric: revision in credit rating of the fixed deposit programme.
Sahyadri Cement upgraded by two notches after deleveraging.
Narmada Textiles: rating agency reaffirms short-term rating.
Vindhya Power's bonds get an outlook change to negative on rising receivables.
Deccan Auto Parts: credit rating action on enhanced bank limits.
Konkan Shipping: disclosure under insider trading regulations, director acquired shares in the open market.
Malabar Spices promoter sells a small stake through the open market.
notes: Promoter sale. Could be filed under takeover rules too; the taxonomy has no separate PROMOTER_STAKE type.

text: Aravalli Mining: designated person disposed of shares, form C received.
Ganga Finance's CEO buys shares worth a modest sum after the results.
Godavari Pharma: promoter group entity acquired shares, disclosure under takeover regulations.
notes: Takeover-code disclosure, not insider-trading code. Same type by our rule; flag if it should split.

text: Nilgiri Tea promoters raise their holding by buying from the market.
Satpura Steel: disclosure of sale of shares by a whole-time director's relative.
Brahmaputra Logistics' founder offloads part of his stake through a block deal.
Tapti Chemicals: trading window closure for designated persons until results.
notes: Looks like insider trading but is routine compliance with no trade. A common false positive for INSIDER_TRADE.

text: Chambal Agro's independent director bought shares two days before a merger announcement.
notes: Mentions a merger, but the event is the director's trade.

text: Kosi Infra: promoter transferred shares to a family trust as an inter-se transfer.
notes: No market sale. Judgement call; could be OTHER.

text: Sindhu Software's chief financial officer sells shares received under the employee stock option plan.
Pench Hospitality: continual disclosure, promoter purchased shares.
Bhadra Bank's promoter trims his holding to meet the regulator's ownership limit.
notes: A regulatory reason drives the sale; the event is still a promoter sale, not REGULATORY_ACTION.

text: Thar Solar: disclosure by a key managerial person on acquisition of shares.
The market regulator fines Kaziranga Foods for late disclosure of related-party deals.
Western Ghats Electric: receipt of a show-cause notice from the stock exchange.
Godavari Pharma receives a warning letter from the US drug regulator for its main plant.
The central bank bars Bhadra Bank from issuing new credit cards.
Kaveri Polymers: penalty levied by the stock exchanges for non-compliance with board composition rules.
The competition regulator raids the offices of Sahyadri Cement and peers.
Narmada Textiles gets environmental clearance for its effluent plant.
notes: Positive regulatory decision. The name REGULATORY_ACTION reads negative; decide whether approvals belong here or in OTHER. Overlaps CAPACITY_EXPANSION when the clearance unlocks a plant.

text: Vindhya Power: order received from the electricity regulatory commission on the tariff petition.
notes: A tariff order is a regulatory decision, neither a penalty nor litigation.

text: Deccan Auto Parts' plant is shut by the state pollution board.
Godavari Pharma's plant clears a US FDA inspection with no observations.
Konkan Shipping: settlement order passed by the market regulator.
Malabar Spices' export consignment is rejected by a foreign food regulator.
Aravalli Mining: the mining lease was suspended by the state government.
Ganga Finance placed under the central bank's prompt corrective action framework.
Sindhu Software: receipt of an income tax demand order; the company will appeal.
notes: Tax demands are very common in filings. REGULATORY_ACTION or LITIGATION? Labelled here as REGULATORY_ACTION (an authority's order); once appealed it becomes LITIGATION. Overlap to resolve.

text: Nilgiri Tea: board approves a bonus issue of one share for every two held.
Satpura Steel to split its shares to improve liquidity.
Brahmaputra Logistics: record date for sub-division of face value.
Tapti Chemicals: board approves a buyback through the tender offer route.
Chambal Agro's open-market buyback closes early after reaching its maximum size.
Kosi Infra: public announcement for buyback of equity shares.
Sindhu Software agrees to acquire a US analytics firm.
Pench Hospitality: scheme of arrangement for demerger of the resorts business approved by the board.
notes: Demerger is a restructuring, not a merger. No RESTRUCTURING type; M_AND_A is the closest.

text: Bhadra Bank and a smaller lender agree to merge, pending approvals.
Thar Solar: commissioning of an additional block of its solar park.
Kaziranga Foods plans a new packaged foods plant in the east.
Western Ghats Electric doubles its transformer capacity with a brownfield expansion.
Kaveri Polymers: disclosure of creation of pledge on promoter shares in favour of a lender.
Sahyadri Cement's promoters release pledged shares after repaying loans.
Narmada Textiles: invocation of pledge on promoter shares by a lender.
notes: An invoked pledge is also a promoter disposal. Overlap with INSIDER_TRADE.

text: A supplier files an insolvency petition against Vindhya Power over unpaid dues.
Deccan Auto Parts: the High Court dismissed the patent suit filed against the company.
Konkan Shipping appeals the regulator's penalty at the appellate tribunal.
notes: Follows a REGULATORY_ACTION. The appeal is the event, so LITIGATION. Overlap with REGULATORY_ACTION.

text: Malabar Spices raises its revenue growth guidance for the year.
Aravalli Mining: production guidance for the coming year shared at the analyst meet.
Ganga Finance withdraws its loan growth outlook citing uncertainty.
India's consumer price inflation eases for the second month in a row.
notes: No instrument. Events with zero instruments are allowed for macro.

text: The central bank holds its policy rate and keeps a neutral stance.
Industrial output growth slows in the latest monthly data.
Cement makers raise prices across southern states.
The government extends a production incentive scheme to specialty chemicals.
notes: Policy aimed at one sector. MACRO_RELEASE or SECTOR_NEWS? Labelled SECTOR_NEWS because it is not a statistical release.

text: Monthly passenger vehicle sales rise across the industry.
notes: Industry data release; overlaps MACRO_RELEASE.

text: Godavari Pharma: intimation of schedule of an analyst and investor meet.
A fire breaks out at Nilgiri Tea's processing unit; no injuries reported.
notes: Operational disruption has no type. Common in practice; consider adding one.

text: Satpura Steel's managing director pledges to buy more shares and then buys a small lot the next day.
notes: The word 'pledges' here means 'promises', not a share pledge. A keyword rule for PLEDGE_CHANGE would misfire.
